sentences.en: It's hard for him to live on his small pension.
sentences.zh: 他的小养老金很难维持生活。

sentences.en: He retired on a pension at the age of sixty.
sentences.zh: 他六十岁退休领取养老金。

sentences.en: Yanni wrote an article about the pension system in Algeria.
sentences.zh: Yanni 写了一篇关于阿尔及利亚养老金制度的文章。
